source: LED Connection Optimus installation manual, bracket SR, DNC1 April 2024 (tools/guides/source)
specs: Luminaire to stand adapter, M8 screw

steps.title: Install the back plate and bracket adapter on the pole with the top bolts, nuts and washers.
Remove the screw and open the cover.
Fix the luminaire on the stand adapter and secure it with the M8 screw.
Connect the cable in the bracket holder to the municipal (supply) wire, as shown in the wiring diagram.
Finally, install the bracket cover and secure it with the screw.
